change.title: Revise Logix and Apple agree limited technical cooperation
change.reason: Move its structural association from process.apple_compatibility to the new NCC development process, which owns the event through a step. Preserve the agreement and event date.

before.title: Logix and Apple agree limited technical cooperation
before.description: Requests documentation, test machines and compatibility assistance for native Apple II FlexiBUS, disk interoperability and Logix video products. Agrees to limited technical cooperation and compatibility assistance.

outcomes.description: Apple accepts Logix-funded native expansion as a way to increase installed Apple II utility, with separate branding/support and no requirement to adopt the full Logix platform; its own peripheral strategy continues.

metadata.description: Pending single-record story changes awaiting whole-record authorization. Reference convention: event -> assumption; matching event/process dates -> period.start/end; strictly interior event -> process.steps; causal event preceding process -> process.inputs; causal process preceding event -> event.inputs. Neither process nor event outcomes reference events. Unknown or overlapping date precision and unproven causal relationships remain for review. Single-parent proposals retain dates and descriptions; a shared event anchor may become a literal calendar boundary to leave the event in one owning process.
